description: This file contains utility functions for handling emoji picker components, including filtering emojis, updating skin tones, organizing emojis into categories and rows, and creating emoji positions and cursor properties within the emoji picker UI.

methods.name: isCategoryHeaderRow
methods.description: Type guard to check if a row is a category header row.

methods.name: updateSkinTone
methods.description: Updates the skin tone of a given system emoji if it differs from the specified skin tone.

methods.name: convertEmojisToUserSkinTone
methods.description: Converts a list of emoji IDs to emojis with the user's skin tone applied.

methods.name: isEmojiIdEqual
methods.description: Checks if two emojis are equal based on their IDs or unified codes.

methods.name: getFilteredEmojis
methods.description: Filters emojis based on a search term, recent emojis, and skin tone.

methods.name: getEmojisByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves emojis belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getUpdatedCategoriesAndAllEmojis
methods.description: Updates emoji categories and the emoji map with recent emojis and skin tone adjustments.

methods.name: calculateCategoryRowIndex
methods.description: Calculates the row index of a category in the emoji grid.

methods.name: splitEmojisToRows
methods.description: Splits a list of emojis into rows for display, based on a fixed number per row.

methods.name: createEmojisPositions
methods.description: Creates a flat list of emoji positions for cursor navigation.

methods.name: createCategoryAndEmojiRows
methods.description: Creates rows of categories and emojis, optionally filtered by a search term.

methods.name: getCursorProperties
methods.description: Retrieves category and emoji indices for cursor positioning based on row and emoji ID.
